chapter: Blackbirds, Carmen Jones and the Ziegfeld Follies
title: Backstage atmosphere: uptown laughter, downtown quiet
summary: Backstage at the Lafayette was noisy with laughing and talking, while at the Ziegfeld show it was silent.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: Well, we're still in the Ziegfeld Follies and the Lafayette Theater.
telling you about the difference between uptown and downtown and you asked what was on when I was downtown and uptown you got to wonder what's on, so much noise going on back stage, you know.
What was the atmosphere back stage before you'd go on up to the theater at Lafayette?
Just a lot of laughing and talking -- laughing and talking, that's uptown.
No laughing or talking or nothing. Show was on.
